caveats:
P-codes prefixed as 'BI' instead of the '003BDI' prefix previously used.

The 'Shape_Area' data in the 'BDI_AdminBoundaries_TabularData.xlsx' gazetteer file are in 'square degrees' which vary in size by latitude and should not be used for actual area calculations.

name: cod-ab-bdi
notes:
Burundi administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 2 levels:  
- Admin 1: 18 Province  
- Admin 2: 119 Commune  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 23 December 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 03 November 2017: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 26 March 2015: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 26 March 2015: boundaries created by the source  
  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
